audit.method: Archived source PDFs under data/raw/SA/<symbol>/documents (SHA-256 re-computed and equal to data/raw/archive-index.json for all 26 archived files). Digital pages: text layer read and the printed figure located. Scanned pages (stc, Zain, Elm primary statements): pages rendered to PNG with PyMuPDF and read by eye, line by line, both columns. Findings are proven with page and line item; 'verified_correct' is claimed only where the printed page was read. Internal arithmetic (subtotals, reconciliations) used only as a secondary check, never as proof. Offline; no AWS, no Supabase, no data/raw edits.

status_vocabulary.verified_correct: printed page read; value, sign, period column, scale and unit match

findings.evidence: The manifest's source is the FY2022 annual report (e42befe5). Its p4 'Financial Highlights' and p22 table print FY2022 EBITDA = 6,161 (SAR m), revenue 15,669, net profit 1,657. 6,179 does not occur anywhere in that PDF. 6,179 is the RESTATED FY2022 comparative printed in the FY2023 annual report (62cf5d09 p3 and p22: 2022 revenue 15,717, EBITDA 6,179, net income 1,657). The manifest therefore combines the original revenue (15,669) and net income with the restated EBITDA from another document.
findings.fix: Either set EBITDA to 6161 (AR2022 vintage, consistent with revenue 15,669) or republish all FY2022 headline facts from the AR2023 comparative column (15,717 / 6,179 / 1,657) with source_url = AR2023; add a basis flag.

findings.evidence: Values are present in the PDFs but not on the cited page: FY2022 cites p12 (printed on PDF p4 and p22), FY2023 cites p8 (PDF p3 and p22), Q1-2023 deck cites p8 for all three facts (PDF p9, p11, p15 - p8 is an ESG slide). mobily-2025-fy uses PDF page numbers (116/117/144) while mobily-2025-deep-financial-notes and issuer-expansion use printed spread numbers (230-286: PDF p = (printed+2)/2), so 80 facts have page numbers beyond the 144-page file; five_g_coverage cites p13 but the statement ('over 96% ... 7 main cities') is on p9. (Machine scan flags 4G/3G coverage 'wrong_page' by false positive: those are printed as '98%'/'99%' on the cited p9 - manually confirmed.)
findings.fix: Use PDF page numbers throughout and keep printed numbers in metadata; re-run scripts/audit_manifest_provenance.py.
